about_the_game:
Colorami is a co-op puzzle platformer where every color holds meaning, every step poses a question, and every solved puzzle brings you deeper into a mysterious, spirited world.

You won't need fast reflexes here. This is a journey of logic, experimentation, and discovery.

The demo version contains a selection of levels to be experienced in local co-op only.

short_description: A co-op puzzle platformer set in a vibrant pixel art world. Change colors on the map to solve asymmetric puzzles, and help two spirits save their forest. Our Demo contains a selection of levels meant to be experienced in local co-op.
